newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan seeks adviser for power plant sale.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan seeks adviser for power plant sale.

text.p: Pakistan's Privatisation Division invited proposals on Thursday to select a financial adviser for the partial sale of three state-owned power plants, a division statement said.

It said the aim was to sell a 26 percent stake and transfer of management control of the 260-megawatt (MW) Multan thermal power station, 376-MW Faisalabad steam and gas turbine station and 840-MW Muzaffargarh steam power station to strategic buyers.

Applications for pre-qualification have been invited up to September 30 from local and foreign investment banks, brokerage houses, management consultants and international business houses to advise on the privatisation of these units.
